scope: Angola medical discovery — Universidade Agostinho Neto Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Universidade Agostinho Neto's official Faculty of Medicine page identifies the faculty, lists Medicine as an undergraduate course, and provides faculty contact details.
A 2025 official UAN notice confirms a dedicated access examination calendar for Medicine.
Angola's higher-education ministry reported a 2025 visit to UAN Faculty of Medicine laboratories and clinical facilities, and described a university hospital under construction at the Camama campus.

holdReasons: No current Medicine tuition and mandatory-fee schedule was located on an official source.
The reviewed 2025 access notice does not establish a current application window, complete document checklist, or a route for international applicants.

The reviewed sources do not clearly confirm instructional language, the current clinical-placement network, programme-level accreditation outcome, accommodation, scholarship, loan, or graduate-registration arrangements.
nextAction: Obtain the active Medicine admissions notice and fee decision directly from UAN, then verify delivery language, clinical placements, recognition and student support before considering a payload.
